Element: Bubble. VFX: a soft light (Rare, Effects.luau): three snore bubbles drift out of its
nose every 4 s (the Burst at Mouth, pale aqua), a soft teal light breathes on its body (pulse
3.4 s) and a white sparkle winks on its tangerine every 4 s (the Sparkle at Halo); the body
breathes 3 percent; in the rig its three lit bubbles bob and circle, its ears twitch and the
tangerine's leaf sways, and every 9 s it snorts awake: a hop and a full turn, ears flared,
bubbles popping up, the leaf swishing
